source.authoring: Original charts with installed Pillow, synthetic speech with FFmpeg/libflite, six ten-second marker segments

recording.method: One approved foreground browser tab and only its tab audio; MediaRecorder; same-origin HTTPS transfer

source_clock_check.method: Three 14-second normalized waveform-correlation windows at distinct recording positions against the known authored source; three sampled visual clock readings
source_clock_check.precision_note: These measurements describe this run; visual clocks are quantized by 15fps source frames. No sample-perfect AV synchronization claim.

captions.authorship: Known authored test ground truth, mapped to the recording clock; not ASR or programme subtitles

limitations: One self-made 60-second clip and one recorder page only
No speech-recognition accuracy or listening-comprehension claim
No long-programme, multi-tab, YouTube or financial-programme validation
872 captured video frames are not a guarantee that all 900 reference frames were preserved
The first 60-second browser attempt produced no file; this report describes only the successful retry
Browser timer suspension and the existing single-client storage restrictions remain

completed_controls.api: prearmed waitForEvent(download) + normal click, then path

completed_controls.route: Blob marker attached anchor, revoke 2 seconds after click

blob_https_control.additional_media_comparisons: No established result; interrupted comparisons unknown and remaining cases not run
blob_https_control.conclusion: A retained small Blob failed to return a workspace artifact within 20 seconds while identical HTTPS bytes succeeded through both supported routes
blob_https_control.evidence_scope: Browser operator records plus independently read/hash-verified HTTPS artifacts; no independent browser replay

interruptions.earlier_workspace_reset: Separate earlier event; not evidence of the Blob timeout cause
interruptions.first_sixty_second_attempt: Temporary browser tabs disappeared before file retrieval; no artifact from that attempt
interruptions.successful_retry: Source and recorder tabs were explicitly marked for retention; successful receipt applies only to this retry

cleanup.evidence_scope: Browser operator UI observation; independent media reviewer did not verify remote deletion

publication_review.scope: Sanitized aggregate validation only; no media, frames, full captions, private URLs, credentials or session identifiers
publication_review.independent_review_scope: Landed media, CLI output hashes/PTS, PCM and waveform checks, three actual clock images; browser operations and deletion remain operator evidence
